title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — were we bound to sin so Adam would? unheard to sin as another's vadem
pass_a_gloss: Were we obliged to sin so that Adam could sin in our place? Placeus says he has never yet heard that anyone can sin loco alterius as that person's surety (vadem)—sin-as-surety is not on the map.
pass_b_english: Were we then bound to sin, so that Adam might sin in our place? For my part it has so far been unheard-of that anyone can sin in another's place as his surety.
source_text: Num igitur peccare tenebamur, ut nostro loco Adamus peccaret? Mihi quidem hactenus inauditum fuit peccare aliquem loco alterius tanquam eius vadem posse.
notes: Cap. IX pro-posteris densify section 637 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 353–354 tip).
